paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy improvement of 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication tasks over multiple iterations, with the x-axis labeled "Iteration" and ranging from 0 to 9 on a linear scale with integer tick labels at intervals of 1, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranging from 0 to 80 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 20. The blue line, representing 6-digit multiplication, starts at 0% accuracy at iteration 0, increases to approximately 35% at iteration 1, then to around 70% at iteration 2, and continues to rise to about 85% at iteration 4, eventually reaching around 92% at iteration 9, with a solid line style and circular markers. The orange line, representing 5-digit multiplication, begins at 0% accuracy at iteration 0, jumps to around 67% at iteration 1, reaches approximately 78% at iteration 2, and then gradually increases to about 85% at iteration 3, stabilizing around 87% at iteration 9, also with a solid line style and square markers.
